camel_example: aliyun esa SetAutomaticFrequencyControlConfig --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234560000 --ActionType js --Enable on --Level normal --SiteVersion 0
description_en: Configures the automatic frequency control threshold for a site
description_zh: 设置站点智能限频阈值
kebab_example: aliyun esa set-automatic-frequency-control-config --site-id 1234560000 --site-version 0 --enable on --level normal --action-type js --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetAutomaticFrequencyControlConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain this ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version of the site. For a site with version management enabled, this parameter specifies the version to which the configuration applies. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic frequency control. Valid values:

on: Enables automatic frequency control.

off: Disables automatic frequency control
parameters.help_zh:
开关。取值：

on: 开启。

off: 关闭
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en:
The protection level. Valid values:

loose: Loose protection.

normal: Normal protection.

strict: Strict protection
parameters.help_zh:
防护等级。取值：
loose：表示宽松。
normal：表示中等。
strict：表示严格
parameters.name: level

parameters.help_en:
The action to take on requests that trigger the control. Valid values:

observe: Monitors the requests.

deny: Blocks the requests.

js: Issues a JS challenge
parameters.help_zh:
处置动作。取值：
observe：表示观察。
deny：表示拦截。
js：表示JS挑战
parameters.name: action_type
